description: Puisards d'égouts is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Élément du système de drainage destiné au captage et à l’acheminement de l’eau de ruissellement vers la conduite d’égout ou le fossé. Structure, munie d’un évacuateur, servant à capter les eaux de ruissellement et à les acheminer, selon le cas, à la conduite d’égout pluvial ou d’égout unitaire. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Combiné, Eau, Eau usée, Infrastructure, Pluvial. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
